title: 第8218章 决斗之日第8217章 黑月酒
content_zh:
次日。
城市之中，某个建筑，陆安就在这里。
陆安在这里待了大半天，除了离开这里，将身体调整到最佳状态外，其他时间都在这里。
陆安找了很多书籍来看，对于这繁月星河的了解多了许多。尤其是黑星河中的一些规矩，也算有一定了解。
至于其他星河势力，他也得到很多情报。
到了时间，他就前往商会。
这商会巨大，决斗场的生意是商会中十分重要的一部分。毕竟无论是卖票还是赌场，都是一笔天大的收益。
陆安到来时，高飞也在。
见到陆安准时到来，高飞顿时眼睛一亮，笑着打不走去。
“我就知道你一定会来，不可能爽约。”
陆安没有多言，高飞带陆安来到一处。工作人员给他独特的令牌，用来证明身份。
“我们只认令牌。”这工作人员说道，“若是令牌丢了，所有成绩都要重新计算。”
陆安接过令牌，他也能理解。毕竟能量身躯随意变化容貌，确实应该只认令牌。
接过令牌，收入指环之中。
“高兄，带他去准备吧。”
“行。”
高飞改变空间，两人离开此地。
两人出现在瀚宇中，但依然在星河之内。
这里是一处空旷的瀚宇，星辰距离这里极其遥远。就算是相元境在这里打得天昏地暗，也绝对不可能波及到任何一个星辰。非要说的话，就相当于星流与星流之间的巨大空档之中。
在这里，有一个巨大的决斗场！

当陆安见到这决斗场的时候，眼神发生变化。
即便他在书籍中看到过很多决斗场的描写，还见过相关的藏神石，但即便如此，亲眼见到这样庞大的决斗场，还是十分震撼。
决斗场内，是完全不会限制实力。
也正因如此，决斗场非常巨大。
这决斗场，当然不是谁都能创建。
要知道，在这决斗场内不仅会有相元境初期的人作战，同样还会有相元境顶级强者作战，必然高飞。高飞也一样在这决斗场内厮杀，而能承受得住顶级相元境的狂暴而不摧毁，就足以说明这决斗场的力量有多么强。
换言之，这决斗场要么是由极其特殊的材料创造而成，要么就是与星河之主有关。
而这两者相比，甚至后者的可能性更大。
毕竟在瀚宇之中，有星河势力，也有非星河势力。星河势力是由很多强大的星河之主组成，但有抱团的星河之主，就有独行的星河之主。这些星河之主也会有自己的势力，把手伸进黑星河再正常不过。
陆安看着前方远处的决斗场，是一片巨大的荒芜。
决斗场有八个角，形成一个巨大的正方体。但这正方体的八面并未连接，什么都看不到，仿佛不存在能量。而这正方体的空间巨大无比，足以让相元境在里面随意厮杀。
而在这八个角所组成的空间之中，不是空无一物，相反有很多岩石。
当然不是普通的岩石，而是在星河中形成的特殊岩石，全部都是相元境级别。
如果昨天来到这决斗场，陆安会问这些岩石的用途，但今天不会。他已经从书籍中得知，这些岩石是为了增加决斗的观赏性，也能够增加一丝不确定性。
这里的岩石大部分都堪比星辰，甚至有的岩石堪比宗星。在这里打起来，确实会十分刺激。
content_en:
The next day.
In a certain building in the city, Lu An is here.
Lu An stayed here for most of the day. Except for leaving here and adjusting his body to the best condition, he spent the rest of the time here.
Lu An read a lot of books and learned a lot more about the many moons and galaxies. In particular, he has a certain understanding of some of the rules in Black Galaxy.
As for other galactic forces, he also received a lot of information.
When the time came, he headed to the Chamber of Commerce.
This chamber of commerce is huge, and the business of the duel ground is a very important part of the chamber of commerce. After all, whether it is selling tickets or the casino, it is a huge profit.
When Lu An arrived, Gao Fei was also there.
Seeing Lu An arriving on time, Gao Fei's eyes suddenly lit up and he couldn't walk away with a smile.
"I knew you would definitely come, there was no way you would break the appointment."
Lu An didn't say much, Gao Fei took Lu An to a place. The staff gave him a unique token to prove his identity.
"We only recognize tokens." The staff member said, "If the token is lost, all results will be recalculated."
Lu An took the token and he could understand. After all, the energy body can change its appearance at will, so it really should only recognize the token.
Take the token and put it into the ring.
"Brother Gao, take him to prepare."
"Okay."
Gao Fei changed the space and the two left here.
The two appeared in Hanyu, but they were still within the galaxy.
This is an empty vast universe, and the stars are extremely far away from here. Even if the Xiangyuan Realm fights here and the sky is dark and the earth is dark, it is absolutely impossible to affect any star. If I have to say it, it is equivalent to the huge gap between the star stream and the star stream.
Here, there is a huge duel field!
When Lu An saw this duel field, his eyes changed.
Even though he had seen many descriptions of dueling arenas in books and had seen the related God-Tiding Stones, even so, seeing such a huge dueling arena with his own eyes was still very shocking.
In the duel arena, there are no restrictions on strength at all.
Because of this, the duel arena is huge.
Of course, not everyone can create this duel field.
You must know that in this duel field, there will not only be people at the early stages of the Xiangyuan Realm fighting, but also top Xiangyuan Realm experts fighting, so they will definitely fly high. Gao Fei is also fighting in this duel field, and being able to withstand the violence of the top Xiangyuan realm without being destroyed is enough to show how powerful this duel field is.
In other words, this duel field is either made of extremely special materials, or it is related to the Lord of the Galaxy.
Compared with the two, the latter is even more likely.
After all, in Hanyu, there are galactic forces and non-galactic forces. The galactic force is composed of many powerful galactic lords, but if there are galactic lords who stick together, there are also galactic lords who walk alone. These galaxy lords will also have their own power, so it is normal for them to reach into the Black Galaxy.
Lu An looked at the duel field in the distance ahead, which was a huge wasteland.
The dueling arena has eight corners, forming a huge cube. But the eight sides of the cube are not connected, nothing can be seen, as if there is no energy. And the space of this cube is huge, enough for Xiangyuan realm to fight at will inside.
And in the space composed of these eight corners, it is not empty. On the contrary, there are many rocks.
Of course they are not ordinary rocks, but special rocks formed in the galaxy, all of which are at the Xiangyuan realm level.
If he had come to this duel field yesterday, Lu An would have asked about the purpose of these rocks, but not today. He has learned from books that these rocks are to increase the viewing pleasure of the duel and also to add a touch of uncertainty.
Most of the rocks here are comparable to stars, and some are even comparable to Zongxing. Fighting here would be very exciting indeed.
